attempted_claim: Let E/Q be semistable of conductor N0, p>=5 of good supersingular reduction with a_p(E)=0, and K imaginary quadratic with (D_K,N0 p)=1 satisfying the generalized Heegner hypothesis (N^- square-free product of an even number of primes) with p inert in K and hypothesis (ram) of Burungale-Buyukboduk-Lei II. With K_infty/K the anticyclotomic Z_p-extension, Lambda=Z_p[[Gal(K_infty/K)]], and Sel^+(K_infty,E), H^1_+(K,T^ac), kappa(1)^+, L^+_p(f) the inert plus objects defined via Burungale-Kobayashi-Ota local points, prove char_Lambda(H^1_+(K,T^ac)/Lambda kappa(1)^+)^2 = char_Lambda(Sel^+(K_infty,E)^vee_tor) in Lambda[1/p], i.e. (L^+_p(f))=(Char^+_p(f)) in the exceptional case, beyond the known one-sided inclusion.
decisive_failure: The CLEAN_EXIT rests on the assessment that four distinct upgrade routes each terminate at presently-unproved inert-plus inputs; it does not prove the target equality false or impossible in principle, only that it is not closable within the pass. The non-vacuity triple E=15a1/p=7/K=Q(sqrt(-599)) was verified except for the technical hypothesis (ram) of Burungale-Buyukboduk-Lei II, which was not machine-checkable. No literature search was consumed. Uncertainty remains only about future developments in inert-plus local Iwasawa theory, which are outside the bounded session.
